title: 457. Insert Delete GetRandom O(1) - Duplicates Allowed

examples.explanation: Sampling entries may be any held value.
One copy of 2 remains after removal.

hints: Keep a list of values plus, per value, the set of list positions holding it.
Insertion appends and records the new index; removal swaps the chosen index with the tail and fixes both index sets.
Sampling draws a uniform list position; the judge accepts any held value.
